title: Nayancode Workbench: open-source bioinformatics and cheminformatics in the web browser
description: Free, open-source analysis studios that run entirely in the web browser: sequence analysis and cloning, read mapping (minimap2 and samtools in WebAssembly), variant interpretation, RNA-seq differential expression for any experimental design (validated against edgeR and limma) and enrichment, single-cell clustering, microbiome diversity, cheminformatics and QSAR, structure analysis and maximum-likelihood phylogenetics. Files are analysed on the user's computer; every result records its provenance and methods text. Published by Vivofold (https://vivofold.in).
